parsed.why: No criminalisation of trans identity, no prison system, no documented traveler-facing restriction; doctrinal hostility and personnel policies are institutional climate signals, not rules binding visitors, and no trans incident at entry or in facilities is recorded.

Official demonisation, scapegoating legislation and societal hostility are documented, but functioning courts, EU oversight findings and large Pride mobilisation temper it; no trans violence, no documented screening of visitors, resident-facing LGR ban doesn't reach foreign documents.

Decriminalisation confirmed by the chief legal officer, no trans-specific offence or enforcement record, no documented targeting; thin data with no acceptance evidence either — no protections and constitutional marriage bar hold it below the fully-accepting tier.

Sodomy statutes with lashing and death penalty, executions, raids and indefinite detentions, forced-surgery regime, official advisories restricting trans presence, custodial rape: state-directed organised targeting with the state as perpetrator.

Official calls for exile of trans people, no legal protections or hate-crime law, documented beating of a gay visitor at carnival, gay-panic acquittals and unsolved murders showing impunity — societal hostility with thin recourse.
